audit.why: Seraphine is immobile with no dash; Rell's W dismount knockup and E Magnet Storm engage close the gap before her shields/Note stacks build. Phase chart already gives Rell every stage, matching the mirror-consistent packet levelChart (all 7 rows Rell) and content win[0-6] (all Rell) — no chart edit needed.

Spikes correctly key level 2 (W-Q all-in before her kit is online), level 6 (Magnet Storm dive before she channels Encore), first item (tank stats eat her poke), and late (point-blank engage still catches a mobility-less mage).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), so they don't actually explain the ability interaction their titles promise.
audit.why: Beat Drop (E) is Seraphine's only hard CC and the ability that can stop Rell's dash; its real cooldown (11s down to 9s) and Encore (R)'s cooldown (160s down to 120s) are the actual engage-window math the field is supposed to carry. missingInteractions also flags that her W (Surround Sound) heals once she's already shielded, which the itemization line references but mis-genders and doesn't name the ability.
audit.corrected: Replaced breakdown.cooldowns with real E/R cooldown numbers; rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to explain their own titles instead of repeating tradeGood/tradeBad; fixed report[8].t pronoun and named Surround Sound (W) as the heal anti-heal targets.

edits.before: - Seraphine Beat Drop (Root): matchup-defining — Roots the already-slowed — dodge it and the song never builds. It writes your spacing rules. - E Full Tilt (remount speed) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Beat Drop (E) is down 11s early, 9s at max rank — spent means your dash-stun window is open. - Encore (R) starts at 160s and drops to 120s late; she won't burn it on a losing trade. - Save your own E (Full Tilt speed) for closing fights, not seasoning trades.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Dash W-Q the instant Beat Drop (E) is down — she has no dash to answer with, and her carry can't shield the trade before your stun lands.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Every wasted mounted second lets Surround Sound (W) tick back up on its 22s cooldown — the longer you wait, the more shield you're diving into.

edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early — Surround Sound (W) heals once she's already shielded, and her duo's sustain war dies without it.

notes: missingInteractions flagged Stage Presence (P) as an 'auto-attack reset' burst tell, but Riot's own text describes it as a triple-cast-empowerment passive (every 3rd spell casts twice; casting near allies buffs her next auto) — not a reset mechanic. The autoReset flag misfired here per the calibration note (trust description over flag), so I did not add that claim to any field. Left it out rather than ship an unverified mechanic.
